title: SimulationEvent
description: One line of worker/src/main.cpp's EventLog output, delivered through two EventSinks: events.ndjson (durable, replayable via GET /simulations/:id/events?since=) and the worker subprocess's own stdout (live -- an api-server already holds a pipe to it the instant it spawns the worker; recommended transport to the browser from there is Server-Sent Events, not WebSocket, since this is a one-directional push and SSE's native Last-Event-ID reconnect maps directly onto the since=<cursor> replay shape below). See worker/README.md's "Live events (transport)" section. ProgressSnapshot below mirrors spida::ProgressSnapshot field-for-field (include/spida/propagator/propagator.h); keep them in sync by hand until there's a generator.

id.description: Monotonic per-simulation event id — the cursor GET /simulations/:id/events?since= and SSE Last-Event-ID replay key off.

seriesName.description: Only meaningful when kind == "report" — matches ResultSeriesDescriptor.name, e.g. "X", "SX".

frameIndex.description: Only meaningful when kind == "report" — 0-based; GET /simulations/:id/results/:series/frames/:i is now servable for this (series, i) pair, and manifest.json's matching series entry has already been rewritten to reflect it (see worker/src/main.cpp's writeManifest()).

ProgressSnapshot.description: Mirrors spida::ProgressSnapshot exactly, including field names (t, tf, stepsTaken, currentStepSize) — see include/spida/propagator/propagator.h.

tf.description: Unset (null) unless the worker called setFinalTime() before running.

currentStepSize.description: Unset (null) unless reported via the stepUpdate(t, dt) overload — see ADR-0001.

SimulationStatus.description: Proposal §9 lifecycle. See openapi.yaml's SimulationStatus for the StopReason -> status mapping this implies.

examples.message: step size clamped to remaining interval
